title: The 10 Industrial Transformation Domains
subtitle: See the Organisation as a Whole
intro: TNI²TRI examines the interconnected capabilities that influence industrial performance and transformation readiness across ten fundamental structural pillars.

domains.name: Industrial Capability
domains.description: Requirements, resource allocation, planning, processes, capacity, productivity, quality and continuous improvement.
keyFocusAreas: Manufacturing and operational throughput
Process standardization and workflow discipline
Equipment effectiveness (OEE) and maintenance
Quality management systems and defect reduction
Lean practices and continuous improvement loops

domains.name: Technology & Digital
domains.description: Technology, digital infrastructure, systems, data, integration, automation, governance and future technology readiness.
keyFocusAreas: Core enterprise systems (ERP, MES, PLM) interoperability
Shopfloor automation, robotics, and IIoT sensor telemetry
Data architecture, analytics pipelines, and single source of truth
Cybersecurity, access controls, and network resilience
AI/ML readiness and digital twin integration capabilities

domains.name: Organisation & Operating Model
domains.description: Structure, roles, decision-making, operating model, management systems, coordination and organisational effectiveness.
keyFocusAreas: Organizational design and reporting clarity
Cross-functional communication and alignment
Delegation of authority and decision velocity
Management operating systems and cadence
Operational agility and friction elimination

domains.name: People & Skills
domains.coreQuestion: Can our people perform and evolve?
domains.description: Workforce capability, skills, leadership capability, learning, training, talent and future skills readiness.
keyFocusAreas: Technical competencies and multi-skilling programs
Frontline upskilling for Industry 4.0 paradigms
Leadership pipeline and managerial readiness
Continuous learning infrastructure and knowledge capture
Talent attraction, retention, and performance culture

domains.name: Innovation & Product Development
domains.coreQuestion: Can we create what comes next?
domains.description: Opportunity identification, customer insight, validation, development, commercial viability, innovation governance and market introduction.
keyFocusAreas: R&D pipeline management and stage-gate governance
Customer-centric co-creation and market problem validation
Prototyping velocity, testing, and simulation capability
Value engineering and design-to-cost principles
Time-to-market acceleration and commercialization readiness

domains.name: Market & Competitiveness
domains.coreQuestion: Are we creating relevant value for the market?
domains.description: Market intelligence, customers, demand, positioning, value proposition, competitiveness, go-to-market and market adaptation.
keyFocusAreas: Competitive positioning and differentiation strategy
Customer segmentation, churn reduction, and lifetime value
Pricing power and value proposition articulation
Channel effectiveness, digital commerce, and export expansion
Responsiveness to shifting macroeconomic and sector demands

domains.name: Supply Chain & Value Network
domains.coreQuestion: Can we reliably access and deliver what is required?
domains.description: Supply strategy, suppliers, sourcing, procurement, inventory, material flow, distribution and supply resilience.
keyFocusAreas: Supplier relationship management and tier-2 visibility
Strategic sourcing, localized vendor ecosystems, and dual-sourcing
Inventory optimization (WIP, raw materials, safety stock)
Logistics, freight efficiency, and on-time in-full (OTIF) delivery
Supply chain disruption resilience and risk mitigation

domains.name: Financial & Economic Capability
domains.coreQuestion: Can the business economically sustain and fund itself?
domains.description: Revenue, cost, margin, cash, working capital, capital allocation, investment, economic value and financial resilience.
keyFocusAreas: Unit economics, cost structure optimization, and margin health
Working capital cycle and cash flow predictability
Capital expenditure (CapEx) governance and transformation budgeting
Return on invested capital (ROIC) and value creation tracking
Financial stress testing and liquidity reserves

domains.name: Governance, Risk & Resilience
domains.coreQuestion: Can we remain protected, responsible and resilient?
domains.description: Governance, accountability, risk, controls, compliance, continuity, crisis response, recovery and resilience.
keyFocusAreas: Statutory, regulatory, environmental, and safety compliance
Enterprise risk management (ERM) and internal controls
Business continuity planning (BCP) and disaster recovery
ESG (Environmental, Social, Governance) sustainability metrics
Audit readiness, transparency, and ethical leadership

domains.name: Leadership, Culture & Transformation
domains.description: Purpose, vision, leadership, culture, strategic choices, transformation design, execution, adoption, institutionalisation, learning and renewal.
keyFocusAreas: Executive alignment, vision clarity, and leadership authenticity
Psychological safety, accountability, and high-performance culture
Transformation program management and change sponsorship
Adoption measurement, resistance management, and pulse tracking
Continuous renewal, adaptability, and institutional learning
